subject: Interviewer bandwidth triage and temporary assignments for candidate week of Mar 27
body:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: talent@smalldata.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interviewer bandwidth triage and temporary assignments for candidate week of Mar 27

Team —

We have a compact interview window for the Senior Infrastructure PM candidate Olivia Park (Greenhouse ID 12345). Hiring manager asked to keep the loop tight: first-round debrief + decision by end of week. Background: Olivia's resume attached; strong infra program-management + infra ML rollout experience.

Constraints: several folks are OOO or heavy on-launch next week. We need to triage interviewer bandwidth and assign temporary coverage so we can keep the slate without delaying the hiring loop. Ask: can each of you confirm capacity or nominate a delegate for Mar 28–30? If you can take a slot, say which time(s) work and whether you can also join a 30m debrief after the final interview (same day).

I attached a simple debrief template and added a provisional calendar invite (will send final once slots are set). If you prefer to hand off, please loop in your delegate (must be an internal Redwood employee).

Thanks — I want to avoid rescheduling with the candidate.

—Monica Patel
Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: resume_olivia_park.pdf, debrief-template.docx

-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interviewer bandwidth triage and temporary assignments for candidate week of Mar 27

Monica —

I can take the technical systems interview on Mar 28 at 10:00–10:45 PT. I have a conflict on the 29th afternoon, so can't do debrief then, but I can join a 30m debrief at 16:00 PT on the 28th if that helps. If you need a backup for the technical slot, aditya.rao can cover — I already flagged him.

—Marcus
Senior Staff Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: talent@smalldata.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interviewer bandwidth triage and temporary assignments for candidate week of Mar 27

I'm available for PM-scope interview on Mar 29 09:00–09:45 PT and can stay on for a debrief at 10:30 PT that day. If the manager wants quicker turnaround, I can do a shorter 20m debrief same morning.

If anyone needs me to take an earlier empathy/behavioral slot, I can swap with aditya for the 28th afternoon.

—Lauren
Hiring Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interviewer bandwidth triage and temporary assignments for candidate week of Mar 27

Quick note on debriefs — please use the attached debrief-template.docx and put a one-sentence signal on risk areas (execution, scale, stakeholder alignment) so the hiring manager can skim. For these compressed loops I prefer a 30m debrief max; if we need a second pass, do a short follow-up with hiring manager only.

Also: if anyone punts coverage, please forward this thread to your delegate and cc me so I can keep the debrief doc up to date.

—Grace
Director, Talent Partnering
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: talent@smalldata.com, olivia.park@example.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interviewer bandwidth triage and temporary assignments for candidate week of Mar 27

Thanks all — final assignments below. I've updated the calendar and attached the invite (calendar-invite.ics). Olivia, welcome — we appreciate your flexibility.

Assignments:
- Mar 28, 10:00–10:45 PT — Technical systems interview: Marcus Lin (backup: Aditya Rao)
- Mar 28, 15:30–16:00 PT — Behavioral/core PM: Aditya Rao
- Mar 29, 09:00–09:45 PT — PM scope / stakeholder alignment: Lauren Bishop
- Debrief: Mar 29, 10:30–11:00 PT — Marcus, Lauren, Grace (hiring manager will join)

Actions:
- Marcus: paste one-paragraph technical risk note into the debrief doc after your interview.
- Lauren: add hiring-manager readiness notes and candidate fit bullets.
- Grace: consolidate and lock the decision window by EOD Mar 30.
- Aditya: cover Marcus's slot only if Marcus informs you directly; otherwise stand by.

Attachments: resume_olivia_park.pdf, debrief-template.docx, calendar-invite.ics

Olivia — you'll receive separate calendar invites; please let us know ASAP if any of these times are a hard no.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference

-----

[thread ends]
